findings.title: Local cache populated before device limit check allows bypassing the limit on subsequent requests
findings.body: In `tagDeviceUI`, `a.localCache.SetDefault(key, struct{}{})` is executed before calling `a.anonStore.CreateOrUpdateDevice(ctx, device)`. When the configured `device_limit` has been reached, `CreateOrUpdateDevice` returns `ErrDeviceLimitReached` and the first request from a new anonymous device is rejected. However, because the device's cache key was already stored in `localCache` (with a 29-minute TTL), any subsequent request from the same device will hit the cache check at line 83 (`if _, ok := a.localCache.Get(key); ok { return nil }`) and succeed without hitting the store, completely bypassing the device limit. `a.localCache.SetDefault(key, struct{}{})` should only be called after `a.anonStore.CreateOrUpdateDevice` succeeds.

findings.title: Changing `ProvideAnonymousDeviceService` signature without updating Wire breaks dependency injection
findings.body: `ProvideAnonymousDeviceService` changed its parameter from `anonStore anonstore.AnonStore` to `sqlStore db.DB`, and `anonstore.ProvideAnonDBStore` changed its signature to require `deviceLimit int64`, but `pkg/server/wire.go` and `pkg/server/wire_gen.go` were not updated in this PR. The server wire provider set still wires `anonstore.ProvideAnonDBStore` and the old `ProvideAnonymousDeviceService` signature, which will fail to compile or fail `make gen-go`.

findings.title: `RowsAffected() == 0` on MySQL can falsely trigger `ErrDeviceLimitReached` for existing devices
findings.body: In `updateDevice`, `result.RowsAffected() == 0` is used to determine that the device was not found within the active window and therefore `ErrDeviceLimitReached` should be returned. On MySQL (when `clientFoundRows` is not enabled on the DSN), `RowsAffected()` returns the number of rows actually changed rather than matched. If an existing active device makes two requests within the same second (MySQL `DATETIME`/`TIMESTAMP` default precision) with the same `client_ip` and `user_agent`, the `UPDATE` matches the row but modifies no column values, so `RowsAffected()` returns 0 and the valid existing device is falsely rejected with `ErrDeviceLimitReached`.
